dataList.title: Explore the Department Store
dataList.description: Something's off. We're back in the restroom, but everyone is acting like they don't remember a thing, and Meursault is nowhere to be seen. This couldn't all have been a dream. Let's look around the department store.

dataList.title: Head to the Casualwear Hall
dataList.description: At least it doesn't seem like it was all a dream. For now, let's keep moving and focus on finding Meursault. He may be back at the same store as last time.

dataList.title: Find Meursault
dataList.description: Meursault should be somewhere nearby. Find him and talk to him.

dataList.title: Show the Mannequins to the Exit
dataList.description: If we want to take Meursault with us, we'll have to do Mimosa a favor first. Let's make quick work of the Mannequins and get out of here.

dataList.title: Show the Mannequins to the Exit (2)
dataList.description: There's no need to drag this conversation out any longer. Let's clear out the Mannequins and move on.

dataList.title: Leave 1F
dataList.description: Things are already going better than last time. If we're going to get a different outcome, we need to keep moving. First priority: get off 1F. We should leave the Casualwear Hall and head for the next store.

dataList.title: Take the Escalator to 2F
dataList.description: We ran into Dubois, who spoke to us last time as well. There's no time for a long conversation, though. Let's head straight to the next floor.
